capabilities: Set per-note wallpapers via a frontmatter property
Randomize backgrounds from a wallpapers list pool
Inherit wallpapers through frontmatter links, body links, or backlinks
Browse and apply wallpapers from a thumbnail gallery
Adjust per-theme overlay opacity for text readability
disambiguation: Not a scheduled or context-aware wallpaper rotator; wallpapers come only from per-note frontmatter, link inheritance, and manual or random picks.
extras: Desktop-only (uses Node.js fs APIs, unavailable on Obsidian Mobile); requires Obsidian 1.13.0+; README includes a filesystem disclosure noting it creates a .cache thumbnail directory inside the plugin folder; one command (Flip Current Wallpaper) overwrites the source image with no undo.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to give individual notes their own background image or to vary the background as you move between notes.
summary: Wallpaper plugin that sets per-note background images via frontmatter, with random pools, link-based inheritance, and a thumbnail gallery picker.
